authority: Math prepares requests; the human owner transmits them; recipient repositories own their own changes.

transition_evidence.draft: Math-local request content only; no external observation implied.
transition_evidence.ready_for_owner: All transmission prerequisites are filled and Math-local validation passes.
transition_evidence.implemented: Recipient result commit or equivalent durable implementation evidence is required.
transition_evidence.verified: Recipient validation evidence plus adopted version/hash or equivalent durable identity is required.

invariants: A Math run never writes to AURA, Decision, MCDM, or another sibling repository.
A Markdown or JSON request cannot by itself advance an external state beyond ready_for_owner.
Math product completion and external adoption state are independent.
A recipient may reject or request changes without invalidating independent Math work.
Duplicate source removal occurs only after recipient consumer qualification and defined rollback.
rollback_contract: Recipient retains its prior source/references in history.
Adoption pins package/version/hash and may revert to the prior source/package without hidden data migration.
Persisted-format changes require a separate migration/rollback plan before adoption.
No same PackageId/version may be republished with different bytes.
